resume: One file of release notes, versioned with the code, and one tool that writes it, the same for every project: each change written in its pull request without a number, rebuilt at the merge (never a conflict), numbered and dated when it ships, with the stories it ships; shown to the users as « What's new ».
apporte: A release-notes file in the repository, one entry per version: number, date and time, title, changes, stories
Entries written in each pull request as « next », without number nor time, rebuilt at the merge by La Fabrique's tool: never a conflict between pull requests
The number given at the merge into an integration branch (without time), or at the release that groups the « next » entries (with the time)
A « What's new » page, newest first, each story linked to its issue
Changes behind the scenes (coulisses), for the team only, kept out of « What's new »
Checks that refuse an entry without its stories, or a « next » entry on the production branch

demande.description: The release-notes file declared in .fabrique.json (version.fichier), the form of its numbers (version.forme), and the project's copy of La Fabrique's release-notes tool (version.outil)
A merge workflow that numbers the entries of the pull request (workflows.fusionner), and a release workflow for a project without integration branch (workflows.publier)
The project's tests or CI run the check on each pull request
